paper_title: Constraints on scalar field dark matter from co-located Michelson interferometers
coupling_convention: Lambda_gamma^{-1} in GeV^{-1} (inverse photon coupling energy scale), exactly as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper constrains scalar-field DM couplings to photons (Lambda_gamma) and electrons (Lambda_e) using cross-correlated Fermilab Holometer twin interferometers, mass range 1.6e-12 to 1.0e-7 eV, at 95% CL, assuming rho_local=0.4 GeV/cm^3 (Relaxion halo uses mass-dependent overdensity). Both ScalarPhoton (Lambda_gamma) and ScalarElectron (Lambda_e) are constrained; hint suggests ScalarPhoton. No numerical coupling values are given in the text; limits appear only in Fig. 2 which cannot be read, so no data points could be extracted.
